name: Phototropism
desc: A rank of seedlings writing down where the light has been — auxin floods each shaded flank so the apex swings toward a lamp that wanders the sky on two incommensurate rates, and because tissue goes rigid the instant it is laid down, every stem grows into a frozen graph of the light's own history while its shadow sweeps the soil beneath it.

energy.doc: tropic responsiveness (how hard stems chase the light) + growth rate + leaf flutter

density.doc: how many seedlings are in the rank (4 at 0 -> 24 at 1)

scale.doc: seedling size vs frame (2.2 = towering stems that leave the frame)

hue.doc: living-stem hue (senescence always drifts it toward straw)

x.doc: bias of the lamp's wandering path across the sky

y.doc: soil line — where the horizon sits in the frame

wander.doc: how far the lamp roams — near 0 it hangs almost still and the stems grow straight; at 1 it ranges and the stems become sinuous records

style.doc: aesthetic — botanical plate w/ lit and shaded flanks and cast shadows; Atkins photogram on Prussian blue; additive translucent radiograph; blueprint schematic with the auxin vector drawn at every apex

seed.doc: seeds germination points, vigour and life spans

alpha.doc: opacity of the seedlings over the ground
